outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the closed cabinet and aligns with the upper drawer handle (frames 0–69, image, left_ego_image and wrist_image), closes its gripper around the handle (frames 70–88, wrist_image), and pulls the drawer outward (frames 99–135, image and left_ego_image). The upper drawer is visibly extended with its sides and interior exposed and remains open as the gripper releases and withdraws (frames 136–152, image, left_ego_image and wrist_image). No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or other unintended side effect is established.
